prompt: Security: with an async request schema (an Ajv schema with $async: true), Fastify treats the validated data as if it were a custom-compiler result of the shape { value, error }. A client can therefore send a body containing a 'value' key to replace the whole request body with it, or an 'error' key to make a valid request fail. Fix validation so that the result an async validator resolves with only decides pass or fail: for a body schema { $async: true, type: 'object', additionalProperties: true, properties: { hello: { type: 'string' } } }, the body { hello: 'world', value: { hello: 'evil' } } must reach the handler unchanged, the body { hello: 'world', error: 'boom' } must succeed with status 200 and reach the handler unchanged, and an invalid body such as { hello: { not: 'a string' } } must still be rejected with 400. The synchronous custom-compiler contract is unchanged: a custom validatorCompiler whose validator returns { value: x } still replaces the request part with x, and one that returns { error } still fails with 400.
requirement: For a promise returned by a validator (async Ajv), the resolved value is used only as pass/fail: false (or a rejection) fails validation; anything else passes and request[paramName] is untouched; its 'value' and 'error' properties are never interpreted. A rejected async validation still yields 400. Synchronous results keep the custom-compiler contract: { error } fails, { value } replaces request[paramName].

oracle.approved_by: Arshad Ahmed Shaik (delegated approval; AI technical review by Claude)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: with the $async body schema, { hello: 'world', value: { hello: 'evil' } } returns 200 and the handler sees exactly that body
with the $async body schema, { hello: 'world', error: 'boom' } returns 200 and the handler sees exactly that body
with the $async body schema, { hello: { not: 'a string' } } is rejected with 400
a synchronous custom validatorCompiler returning { value: x } replaces the body with x; returning { error } fails with 400

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev screen, harder candidates)
provenance.notes: Real security defect in fastify v5.12.1 (GHSA-667r-xxjv-c9mm: async validator results unwrapped as { value, error }), fixed upstream in f02d8d4a. The reference is that fix applied to v5.12.1. The hidden suite is the upstream tests plus the invalid-async and synchronous-contract cases the prompt states.
